messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync  Scarab dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:30 PT. Objectives: quota handoff, autoscale tuning, two-phase load tests, KMS rotation window. Need final quota + billing tag now. @sam_engineering @priya_sre

sam_engineering: Quota confirmed: 50k tokens/min across 3 reserved slots (start with 3 workers). Hardware: 3x A100-80GB reserved, burst cap = 6 workers. Billing tag: account=scarab-dedicated-2026. Will open infra PR with configs today.

priya_sre: SRE notes: set min_replicas=2. Autoscale: cpu_target=60%, token_rate_window=30s, scale_cooldown=90s. Run a 20m shadow canary before shifting real traffic. KMS rotation pinned to 10:45 PT (avoid overlap with loadtest ramp).

maria_cs: Customer requested a documented fallback if primary pool saturates 1% traffic. Proposed fallback model: gpt-neox-20b-quant (cheaper, higher latency). @eli_cloud_ops can you confirm routing compatibility?

eli_cloud_ops: Confirmed. Added routing rule scarab-prod -> scarab-fallback with priority 0. Fallback adds ~350ms median latency; logged details in runbook.

sam_engineering: Infra PR #4821 contains routing + cache warmup hooks. Warmup job example:
```
# warmup job
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"scarab-primary","prefixes":["Hi","Order status","/lookup"]}'
```
Schedule: warmup runs at T-15 and T-5 before traffic shift.

ops_bot: Reservation created: loadtest-scarab-178999 (10:00-11:30 UTC). Resource lock on pool: scarab-prod. Incident channel reserved: #eng-oncall. :calendar:

jordan_re: Shared onboarding bundle to Scarab PM: https://docs.internal/redwood/scarab-onboard (includes runbook, escalation matrix, SLAs). Customer asked for a 30m walkthrough after canary.

maria_cs: Execution timeline: 09:30 sync, 09:40 KV warmup, 09:50 shadow canary (20m), 10:15 ramp to 50% (obs check), 10:30 full loadtest to validate autoscale, 10:45 KMS rotate (if green), 11:15 postmortem notes. Call out blockers now.

priya_sre: Blocker: confirm no infra deploys to serving fleet between 09:00-12:00 PT. Need release team acknowledgement.

sam_engineering: We'll hold infra deploys; I'll notify release ops and attach the loadtest script + traffic profile here.

maria_cs: Scarab asked for 48h P95 latency and tail error counts captured into dashboards. Can we wire that into Console? @sam_engineering @priya_sre

eli_cloud_ops: Created dashboard: Scarab > Health > Latency & Errors. Also set up daily CSV export to CS mailbox.

maria_cs: Great. I'll send customer prep email at EOD and confirm the walkthrough slot. Unless new blockers, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
